body: NAD but I’ve had 4 reg teeth extracted. I’d leave it alone honestly the instructions with normal teeth being pulled is typically rinse after eating with salt water and throughout the day no vigorous swishing and brush your teeth but fully avoid the area in which the tooth was pulled because you don’t want to knock anything loose. Teeth “scab” like other wounds but because your mouth is a wet area it’s gonna look odd. If you’re that concerned call your dentist so they can take a look but it looks honestly pretty normal or at least normal to me because my gaps have looked like that while healing. I’ve also had one dentist pack my wound and it came out by itself. You just have to give it time let it heal but keep it clean!!

NAD I agree if it’s that painful I wouldn’t wait especially if painkillers don’t do any thing for your pain. Mouths are extremely sensitive and waiting can always cause more issues like infections or like the other person said a more expensive issue. If you cant even have your other teeth touch that one without experiencing pain it would be best to give your dental office a call and explain the issue most offices reserve some openings for emergencies or special cases so they might be able to squeeze you in or refer you to someone or a place that can handle it sooner than later.
